en: Sepia-toned historic street view showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story stone and brick buildings leading to a large round defensive tower with a conical roof in the background. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. A shop sign with the word "KODAK" hangs on the right. Handwritten-style caption at the bottom reads "Riga – am Pulverturm" and small printed text in the lower right reads "ZUDUSI LATVIJA".
